name: The Badger's Moon
source:
"It's just... A badger tradition you don't have to worry about."

---

A couple of husbands, William the Wasgo and Brock the Badger, had been married for around two months already, and as a bit of tradition comes around, this may be the moment for the two to finally talk and finally try to break down the walls that had formed around them.

[From [url=https://wolfrang-stromhills.itch.io/the-badgers-moon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“这只是……獾的传统，你不必担心。”

---

一对丈夫，瓦斯戈威廉和獾布洛克，已经结婚大约两个月了，随着一些传统的出现，这可能是两人最终交谈并最终试图打破他们周围形成的墙的时刻。

[来自[url=https://wolfrang-stromhills.itch.io/the-badgers-moon]Itch.io[/url]]
